**Situation**: the measured pair (`list_issue_types` 403 / `issue_write type:` succeeds) remains valid and un-refuted. Its delivery vehicle (a bundled trap-table PR) was closed unmerged by ruling that named **only the sibling card**; whether the void extends to this row was asked in the 2026-08-14 shift report and never answered. Re-dispatching a row the maintainer just declined to merge would re-litigate; closing it would extend the void without authorization. So the question moves from a chat report (where it has no durable reader) onto this card.

**The decision**: should this one measured trap row land in `references/platform-readings.md`, or is the card itself the record?

- **Platform long-term coherence**: the fact table exists precisely so seats stop re-falling into measured traps; one row narrows a documented ambiguity. Leaving it card-only means every future seat must find this card to avoid the trap.
- **Measured business pull**: the trap fired in a real triage round; the native-type discipline (triage as sole type producer) operationally depends on seats not probing the list first.
- **AI-agent error-resistance**: the row closes two wrong exits (silently dropping the type discipline, or reporting the mandate as blocked) — a loud, specific instruction beats each seat re-deriving it.
- **Startup scope discipline**: one line, zero maintenance obligation; but the maintainer already closed one PR carrying it — if the intent was "cards are the record, no more trap-table growth", the right outcome is close-not-planned and this block records why.

**Recommendation**: land the single row (options A) — it is one line with a named reader — unless the earlier PR closure was meant as a general "stop growing the trap table", in which case close this card not planned (option B). One word (A/B) suffices; the seat executes either atomically.
